meta.name: itr-wala
meta.description: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax, advance tax, or the income-tax e-filing portal - even if they just say "help me with my taxes" in an Indian context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 填报印度个税,核对退税与资本利得
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在印度工作或投资,需要申报个税
copy.tagline_en: File Indian income tax returns, track refunds and capital gains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work or invest in India and need to file personal income tax.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导你准备2025-26财年的印度报税：收集Form 16、AIS等材料，把金额原样记下，由本机Python脚本校验并计算两种税制的税额与退税，再把对比结果和填表指南整理给你；支付、提交和e-Verify由你亲自完成。
howto.when: 当用户表现出印度2025-26财年报税需求（如申报ITR、核对Form 16/AIS等文件）时触发；哪怕只对Claude说“帮我处理税务”也会触发。

say.text: 我要申报2025-26财年ITR，有Form 16和AIS，下一步怎么做？
say.note: 会引导你把文件放入工作区并开始整理数据。

say.text: 这是我的Zerodha交易报表，帮我算资本利得并比较新旧税制。
say.note: 会提取资本利得数据并让脚本算出两种税制结果。

say.text: 帮我核对Form 16和26AS的TDS是否一致。
say.note: 会逐项核对两份文件的TDS总额，向用户指出差异。

howto.what_en: Claude guides Indian tax filing: it collects your Form 16/AIS documents, copies amounts verbatim, runs local Python scripts to compute tax/refund under both regimes, and prepares a filing pack for you to submit and e-verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered for Indian tax filing tasks such as filing an ITR for FY 2025-26, reviewing Form 16/AIS/26AS documents, or even just saying “help me with my taxes”.

say_en.text: I want to file ITR for FY 2025-26; I have Form 16 and AIS. What's next?
say_en.note: It sets up the workspace and starts collecting documents.

say_en.text: Here is my Zerodha statement; compute capital gains and compare tax regimes.
say_en.note: It extracts the transactions and runs the tax engine.

say_en.text: Check whether TDS on my Form 16 matches Form 26AS.
say_en.note: It validates totals and flags any mismatch.
